title: Percent of total
context: ALL removes the filter for the denominator.
task: Write a measure = total SalesAmount divided by the grand total across all products, using DIVIDE and ALL(Product).

title: Grand total (ignore all filters)
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount ignoring any filters, using CALCULATE and ALL(Sales).

title: Corporate Electronics
context: Two filter arguments combine with AND.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where category is 'Electronics' AND segment is 'Corporate'.

title: Big-basket sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount from Sales rows where Quantity > 5, using CALCULATE and FILTER.

title: Deep-discount sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Discount >= 0.1, using CALCULATE and FILTER.

title: Profit with variables
task: Write a measure using VAR Rev = total SalesAmount, VAR Cost = total CostAmount, RETURN Rev − Cost.
answer: VAR Rev = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) VAR Cost = SUM(Sales[CostAmount]) RETURN Rev - Cost

title: Margin with variables
task: Write a measure: VAR Rev = total SalesAmount RETURN DIVIDE(Rev − total CostAmount, Rev).
answer: VAR Rev = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) RETURN DIVIDE(Rev - SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), Rev)

title: Year-to-date sales
task: Write a measure for year-to-date SalesAmount using TOTALYTD and Date[Date].

title: Same period last year
task: Write a measure for SalesAmount in the same period last year, using CALCULATE and SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date]).

title: YTD via DATESYTD
task: Write a measure for YTD SalesAmount using CALCULATE and DATESYTD(Date[Date]).

title: Prior year via DATEADD
task: Write a measure for last year's SalesAmount using CALCULATE and DATEADD(Date[Date], -1, YEAR).

title: Year-over-year growth %
task: Write a measure: VAR Cur = sales in 2024, VAR Prev = sales in 2023, RETURN DIVIDE(Cur − Prev, Prev).
answer: VAR Cur = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year] = 2024) VAR Prev = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year] = 2023) RETURN DIVIDE(Cur - Prev, Prev)

title: Electronics share of total
task: Write a measure: VAR E = Electronics sales, VAR T = total sales, RETURN DIVIDE(E, T).
hint: CALCULATE for E, plain SUM for T.
answer: VAR E = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Product[Category] = "Electronics") VAR T = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) RETURN DIVIDE(E, T)

title: Revenue of large orders
task: Write a measure = SUMX over FILTER(Sales, Sales[Quantity] > 5) of SalesAmount.

title: Line-level profit
task: Write a measure = SUMX over Sales of (SalesAmount − CostAmount).

title: Average line margin %
task: Write a measure = AVERAGEX over Sales of DIVIDE(SalesAmount − CostAmount, SalesAmount).

title: Total product count
task: Write a measure counting all products regardless of filter, using COUNTROWS and ALL(Product).

title: 2024 Electronics sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where year is 2024 and category is 'Electronics'.

title: Profitable flag
task: Write a measure returning 'Yes' if total SalesAmount > total CostAmount, else 'No'.

title: Margin grade
task: Write a measure: VAR M = margin (profit / sales) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), M >= 0.5, "A", M >= 0.4, "B", "C").
answer: VAR M = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) - SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), M >= 0.5, "A", M >= 0.4, "B", "C")

title: Non-electronics sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where category is not 'Electronics'.

title: Spread of product prices
task: Write a measure = MAXX(Product, Product[Price]) − MINX(Product, Product[Price]).

title: Sales of cheap products
context: Filter the product table by price.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount from products priced under 200, using CALCULATE and FILTER(Product, ...).

title: Average discount
task: Write a measure for the average Discount, rounded to 3 decimals with ROUND.

title: South segment SMB sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where region is 'South' and segment is 'SMB'.

title: Electronics quantity share
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(Electronics quantity, total quantity) using CALCULATE and ALL(Product).

title: Prior-year sales via variables
task: Write a measure: VAR Cur = total SalesAmount, VAR PY = CALCULATE(total, SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])) RETURN Cur − PY.
answer: VAR Cur = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) VAR PY = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])) RETURN Cur - PY

title: Products above average price
context: Compare each product to the overall average.
task: Write a measure counting products whose Price is above the average product Price, using COUNTROWS, FILTER and AVERAGE.
